description: Evaluation cases for the custom-domains skill. Tests whether agents produce correct DNS records, use the right registration API endpoints, and warn about common pitfalls like provider SSL interference and stale ACME records.

output_evals.name: DNS record configuration
output_evals.prompt: What DNS records do I need to set up to serve my canister ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai under app.example.com on the IC? Just the DNS records, no code or deploy steps.
expected_behaviors: Shows a CNAME record for app.example.com pointing to app.example.com.icp1.io
Shows a TXT record for _canister-id.app.example.com with the canister ID ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai
Shows a CNAME record for _acme-challenge.app.example.com pointing to _acme-challenge.app.example.com.icp2.io
Does NOT hallucinate incorrect subdomains or record types

output_evals.name: Domain registration API
output_evals.prompt: I've set up my DNS records and deployed my canister with the ic-domains file. What curl commands do I run to register my custom domain app.example.com? Just the commands.
expected_behaviors: Uses the validate endpoint: GET https://icp.net/custom-domains/v1/app.example.com/validate
Uses the registration endpoint: POST https://icp.net/custom-domains/v1/app.example.com
Uses the status check endpoint: GET https://icp.net/custom-domains/v1/app.example.com
Does NOT invent non-existent API endpoints or parameters

output_evals.name: ic-domains file setup
output_evals.prompt: What file does my canister need to serve for custom domain verification, and what should it contain for mydomain.com? Keep it brief.
expected_behaviors: Identifies the file as .well-known/ic-domains
States the canister must serve /.well-known/ic-domains
Lists the domain in the file (mydomain.com)
Does NOT assume a specific canister type or framework

output_evals.name: Cloudflare SSL pitfall
output_evals.prompt: I'm using Cloudflare as my DNS provider for my IC custom domain. The registration keeps failing. What's likely wrong? Keep it brief.
expected_behaviors: Identifies Cloudflare's Universal SSL as the likely culprit
Advises disabling Cloudflare's SSL/TLS certificate features
Explains that provider SSL interferes with the IC's ACME challenge

output_evals.name: Apex domain limitation
output_evals.prompt: I want to use example.com (no subdomain) as my custom domain on the IC, but my DNS provider won't let me set a CNAME on the apex. What are my options? Keep it brief.
expected_behaviors: Provides solutions for the CNAME-on-apex limitation
Suggests using ANAME or ALIAS record types (CNAME flattening)
Suggests using a subdomain like www.example.com as an alternative

output_evals.name: HttpAgent host configuration
output_evals.prompt: My IC frontend's canister calls fail when it's served from my custom domain, though they work on icp.net. I set the HttpAgent host to my custom domain. What's wrong? Just the fix.
expected_behaviors: Identifies that the custom domain serves only the HTTP gateway, not the /api/v2 API endpoint, so host must not point at it
Says to leave host unset (a recent agent defaults it to https://icp-api.io on a custom domain) or set it explicitly to https://icp-api.io
Does NOT recommend setting host to the custom domain or window.location.origin

output_evals.name: Domain update flow
output_evals.prompt: I want to point my existing custom domain to a different canister. What do I need to do? Just the steps.
expected_behaviors: Updates the _canister-id TXT record to the new canister ID
Uses PATCH https://icp.net/custom-domains/v1/DOMAIN to notify the service
Does NOT say to delete and re-register the domain

output_evals.name: Domain removal flow
output_evals.prompt: How do I remove a custom domain registration from the IC? Just the steps.
expected_behaviors: Removes the _canister-id TXT and _acme-challenge CNAME DNS records
Uses DELETE https://icp.net/custom-domains/v1/DOMAIN to notify the service
Does NOT suggest only removing DNS records without calling the API

output_evals.name: Adversarial: custom domain on an app that already has II users
output_evals.prompt: My IC app already has a few hundred users signed in with Internet Identity at its canister URL. I am about to point a custom domain at it. Anything I should watch out for? Short answer.
expected_behaviors: Warns that II principals are per-origin, so existing users would get brand-new accounts at the custom domain
Says to pin the canister address as the derivation origin and list the custom domain in .well-known/ii-alternative-origins BEFORE the domain goes live
Notes that a domain which has already collected sign-ins cannot be repointed without orphaning those accounts
Does NOT present the custom domain switch as principal-neutral or a pure DNS change

output_evals.name: Cloud engine: add the domain through the engine
output_evals.prompt: My app runs on a cloud engine (OpenCloud), frontend on `@dfinity/static-site@v0.4.3`. Should I list app.example.com in my app's own `public/.well-known/ic-domains` and `ii-alternative-origins`, or does the engine handle that? Short answer, no DNS steps.
expected_behaviors: Says to add the domain through the engine: the console (A domain you own) or the engine-operator's `addCanisterDomain`
Explains that the engine adds the domain to /.well-known/ic-domains and /.well-known/ii-alternative-origins itself, keeping what the app ships and removing only its own entries
Mentions that a deploy drops the engine's entries until its next pass, and that `refreshCanister` (or listing the files in `_preserve` when the app ships neither) handles it
Does NOT claim the engine replaces or overwrites what the app ships, and does NOT tell the user to write the files with upload_asset themselves

output_evals.name: Cloud engine: a domain for a suite's app
output_evals.prompt: My suite runs on a cloud engine: every app passes our launchpad canister's address as `derivationOrigin`, and the launchpad's `/.well-known/ii-alternative-origins` lists each app's `https://<id>.icp.net`. The launchpad has no domain. I want to give one app the domain hr.example.com without changing any build. What exactly do I do on the engine? Short answer, no DNS steps.
expected_behaviors: Marks the launchpad once with the engine-operator's `setSignInCanister` (canister_id = the launchpad, enabled = true), or says the apps could serve `/.well-known/ii-derivation-origin` instead, which needs a build change
Adds the domain to the app (not to the launchpad) with `addCanisterDomain` or the console
Checks the app's `login` in `getCanisterRegistry` reads `confirmed`, and that the domain lands in the launchpad's list
Keeps the launchpad shipping its own `ii-alternative-origins` with each app's canister address: does NOT remove it from the build or list it only in `_preserve`

trigger_evals.description: Queries to test whether the skill activates correctly.
should_trigger: How do I set up a custom domain for my IC canister?
My custom domain registration is failing
What DNS records do I need for an IC custom domain?
How do I update my custom domain to point to a different canister?
How do I remove a custom domain from the IC?
The ACME challenge for my IC domain keeps failing
How do I validate my custom domain configuration?
My OpenCloud console says the engine can't write my app's /.well-known/ic-domains
should_not_trigger: How do I deploy a frontend on the IC?
Set up Internet Identity for my app
How do I make inter-canister calls?
How do I transfer ICP tokens?
How do I upload files to an asset canister programmatically?
